scope: Scene presentation and click-selection changes in web/src/scene.ts. Records completed non-browser checks; does not claim browser interaction coverage.

checks.name: scene presentation preferences
assertions: shared route colour across hand and foot types
original bundle and calculation fingerprints unmodified

checks.name: placement geometry parity
assertions: multi-axis panel rotation and translated origin
front corner elevation measured above y=0 separately from layout height
saved wall profile panel corners, placement axes and selected mesh contact frames

checks.name: scene camera and near-pick in-memory harness
checks.kind: Node algorithm check; not a browser interaction test
checks.execution: Run the source below with node through stdin (node <<'NODE' ... NODE) from web/. esbuild bundles the current scene.ts in memory with write:false. Module._compile receives a virtual absolute filename; no __scene-check.cjs or test script is written.
checks.method: Calls WallView prototype methods on explicit fixtures without invoking its browser constructor. Uses real Three.js cameras, model geometry, projection and raycasting; substitutes only canvas bounds and the minimal controls state. The picking case uses synthetic 3 cm geometry and a separate opaque blocker.

assertions: all padded route-envelope corners fit within portrait NDC [-1,1]
desktop returns no portrait route bounds
visible hold selected at 10 px centre offset
hold ignored at 13 px centre offset
hold behind an opaque blocker ignored

limitations: No DOM event dispatch, WebGL render, touch input or browser click sequence is exercised.
This harness does not verify marker layout, controls damping or preservation of gestures in a browser.
The camera fixture is setting-diagonal_balance-bundle.json, not the compact-strength browser screenshot.

browser_visual_validation.note: Browser visuals and end-to-end interactions are owned and evidenced by the root task. This file records only this subagent's Node, TypeScript and geometry checks.
browser_visual_validation.reported_observation_source: Root agent handoff message, not a browser execution by this subagent.
